title: Chawri Bazar building collapse: CM orders inquiry, FIR against contractor
description:
Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Thursday ordered an inquiry into the collapse of a three-storey building under construction in Old Delhi's Chawri Bazar, which claimed two lives and left four others injured, and directed the registration of an FIR against the contractor.
The chief minister also ordered the immediate suspension of the concerned junior engineer (JE) and assistant engineer (AE) in connection with the incident.
She directed officials to ensure the best possible medical treatment for the injured and provide immediate ex-gratia assistance to the affected families.
"Stringent action will be taken against those found responsible, in accordance with the law," the chief minister said.
The building collapsed around 9.50 am in Gali Sitara, near the Chawri Bazar Metro station, police said.
Two bodies were pulled out from the debris by a Delhi Fire Services (DFS) rescue team, while four injured people were taken to a hospital by locals before the fire department teams arrive
